mentions.name: Torpor
mentions.description: A full-stack JavaScript framework, now faster and with more built-in components, featuring single-file code routing that can be migrated to full file routing as a site grows. Started by a human but now mostly implemented by robots.
mentions.source_excerpt: I've also been working on my full-stack JS framework (https://github.com/andrewjk/torpor) which is now faster, has more built-in components, and has single file code routing which can be migrated to full file routing when your site gets bigger

mentions.name: Torpor
mentions.description: A full stack JavaScript framework in which components are JS functions containing UI that is mostly HTML, with reactivity handled through proxied objects.
mentions.source_excerpt:
In my free time this year I've been working on a full stack JS framework called Torpor: https://torpor.dev (https://github.com/andrewjk/torpor)

Components are JS functions, containing UI that is (mostly) HTML, with reactivity only via proxied objects.
